{"file_name":"projects/voice-assistant/PLAN.md","content":"# Saut · Project Plan
*Last updated: 2026-10-29*

## Goal
Working prototype of the Arabic (Gulf) voice assistant **Saut**, demoed in **Lab 3 on 2026-11-15**,
then final report submitted **online by 2026-12-10**.

**Demo definition of done:** a user speaks a Gulf Arabic command → Saut transcribes it → identifies the
intent → executes a real action → replies by voice. End-to-end, no crashes, works live.

## Approach (decided 2026-10-29)
**Hybrid intent parser**: rule/pattern matching for the 50 recorded commands (deterministic, offline,
never fails on stage) + LLM fallback for everything out of scope. If the LLM is unavailable, the demo
still runs fully on rules. Confirm this with Dr. Noura at the next meeting — she has veto power.

## Assumed capacity
~2h/day on Saut until the IS midterm (Nov 5), then ~4h/day until the demo. Buffer is built into Nov 13–14.

---

## Phase 1 — Freeze the pipeline (Oct 29 → Nov 4)
| Task | Output | Days |
|---|---|---|
| Meet Dr. Noura, approve hybrid parser + demo scope | signed-off scope | Oct 29–30 |
| Lock the command list to exactly 50, grouped by intent | `commands.csv` | Oct 30 |
| Tune Whisper for Gulf dialect (hotwords, beam size, punctuation off) | WER measured on the 50 clips | Oct 31 – Nov 1 |
| Define intent schema (name, slots, expected reply) | `intents.yaml` | Nov 1 |
| Commit + tag working STT baseline | git tag `stt-baseline` | Nov 2 |
| *(IS midterm — Nov 5, B-12 — keep evenings light Nov 4)* | | |

**Gate:** transcription of the 50 clips is accurate enough to act on, and the intent list is frozen.

## Phase 2 — Intent parser (Nov 5 → Nov 9)
Light days Nov 5–6 (post-exam recovery), heavier Nov 7–9.
| Task | Output |
|---|---|
| Rule matcher: Arabic normalization (أ/إ/آ/ا, ة/ه, ى/ي, tashkeel stripping) | normalizer module + unit tests |
| Pattern + keyword matching for every intent in `intents.yaml` | matcher module |
| Slot extraction (time, city, name, number) | extractor module |
| LLM fallback path with strict JSON output + confidence threshold | fallback module |
| Evaluation script over the 50 clips | intent accuracy report |
| **Target: ≥ 90% intent accuracy on the 50 clips** | |

**Gate:** every one of the 50 clips maps to the right intent end-to-end.

## Phase 3 — Actions, TTS & integration (Nov 10 → Nov 12)
| Task | Output |
|---|---|
| Implement 4–6 demo-worthy skills (e.g. timetable query, timer/reminder, weather, notes, course deadlines) | working actions |
| Text-to-speech reply in Arabic + barge-in handling | voice output |
| Wire STT → parser → action → TTS into one loop, mic-to-speaker latency < ~3s | integrated app |
| Minimal UI: mic button, transcript, intent shown (useful for the audience) | demo screen |

**Gate:** a live end-to-end session with no manual intervention.

## Phase 4 — Harden & rehearse (Nov 13 → Nov 15)
| Task | Output |
|---|---|
| Nov 13: full test on the 50 clips + 10 unseen ones; fix top failures; **offline mode** for flaky Wi-Fi | hardened build |
| Nov 14: rehearse the demo script 3× out loud; record a **full video backup** of it working; pack backup laptop/USB | demo kit |
| Nov 15: arrive early, test mic + network in Lab 3 before the slot | demo delivered |

## Phase 5 — After the demo (Nov 16 → Dec 10)
- Nov 16–20: AI final prep (revise ch. 3 search), Saut on pause except bug fixes.
- Nov 21 – Dec 3: write the final report (intro, related work, system design, evaluation table with
  WER + intent accuracy, limitations, future work). Draft by Dec 5, supervisor feedback, submit Dec 10.
- Dec 4 onward: Cloud Computing final takes priority.

---

## Risks & mitigations
| Risk | Mitigation |
|---|---|
| Whisper mangles Gulf dialect | hotwords + the 50-clip test set early (Phase 1), not in week 3 |
| LLM API down / no Wi-Fi in Lab 3 | rules-only offline mode; the demo must pass without any API |
| Scope creep (too many skills) | 4–6 skills max, all drawn from the frozen command list |
| Parser not ready by Nov 9 | cut the LLM fallback, ship rules-only, mention it as future work |
| Midterm + project collide Nov 1–6 | 2h/day cap before Nov 5, light days Nov 5–6 |

## Metrics to report
- Word error rate of STT on the 50 Gulf clips.
- Intent accuracy on the 50 known + 10 unseen commands.
- End-to-end latency, mic to spoken reply.

## Next three actions
1. Message Dr. Noura today to book the meeting (intent parser approval).
2. Freeze the command list into `commands.csv`.
3. Start Whisper dialect tuning.
"}
